item.title: The Best Moments From KCON LA 2026 (So Far)
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Get ready, K-pop fans! Los Angeles is officially taken over by the ultimate K-pop experience - KCON LA 2026! I'm your host, and I'm excited to bring you all the highlights from this epic festival.
[Short music transition]
Host: "KCON officially kicked off on Friday at the Los Angeles Convention Center and Crypto.com Arena, with the theme 'Walk in SOUL CITY'. But the city has been buzzing with K-pop energy all week. HYBE America started the party on Wednesday with an industry bash, featuring boy bands &TEAM and Santos Bravos, as well as a special appearance by Eric Nam.
[Short music transition]
Host: "And it's not just the big festivals - the retail circuit has become a parallel festival of its own. Fans have been meeting their favorite artists at near-daily signings and events, thanks to retailers like hello82 and KPop Nara.
[Short music transition]
Host: "Now, let's talk about the main event. The KCON festival grounds opened at 10 am on Friday, with multiple stages featuring a packed lineup of artists. And for the first time in KCON history, the daily headliners are performing full hour-long sets. That's right, no more abbreviated performances - fans get to enjoy a full hour of their favorite acts!
[Short music transition]
Host: "KCON has been a launchpad for some of the biggest K-pop acts, including BTS, TWICE, and SEVENTEEN. And with this year's festival, it's clear that K-pop is here to stay in LA. In fact, the city even designated August 1st, 2025 as 'KCON Day'.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's a wrap for day one of KCON LA 2026. Stay tuned for more highlights and updates throughout the weekend. Thanks for tuning in, and don't forget to follow us for all the latest K-pop news and updates!"
